text:
Delhi to Mumbai Expressway was promised by 2024. As of March 2026, 929 of its 1,445 km was open, about 64%.

Delhi to Vadodara missed its June 2026 target, and the last packages near Maharashtra are now due March 2028. So if a Gurugram, Jaipur or Vadodara listing says "minutes from the expressway", check which stretch is actually open.

Source: MoRTH reply in Rajya Sabha via Business Today. #infrastructure
